chunks: They will be guided to the good of speech, and guided to the path of the Praiseworthy.

key_terms.الْحَمِيدِ: The Praiseworthy (one of the names of Allah)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of being guided to 'the good of speech' in Surah Al-Hajj?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a contrast between the guidance granted to the faithful and the misguidance of their opponents, emphasizing that true success lies in both internal conviction and external expression. The 'good of speech' is seen as the fruit of inner purity, while the 'path of the Praiseworthy' signifies the ultimate destination of nearness to Allah, reflecting the dual nature of spiritual ascent. This guidance is viewed as a divine grace that perfects the believer's character, aligning their words and deeds with the attributes of the Divine.
